source_prompt: A surreal night scene featuring five chubby pink and green anthropomorphic pigs huddled together on a grassy hill under a large glowing orange full moon with the words GAB CAST written across it. Northern lights swirl in a dark purple starry sky. The pigs wear gold earrings, one has a blue bow tie, another has a small house built on its back. Speech bubbles with keys float around them. Glowing mushrooms and puddles with jellyfish-like creatures surround them, bare twisted trees frame the scene, in a detailed whimsical fantasy painting style.
